name: If I'm selling FSBO, how can I ensure my asking price accounts for negotiation room?

mainEntity.name: If I'm selling FSBO, how can I ensure my asking price accounts for negotiation room?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selling FSBO, ensuring your asking price accounts for negotiation room requires strategic planning. While it might be tempting to build in a large buffer, overpricing significantly can deter buyers from even viewing your property. Instead, base your initial price firmly on a thorough comparative market analysis, identifying a range where similar homes have recently sold in your area, such as Williams Island or Pompano Beach. Then, consider adding a modest negotiation margin, perhaps 1-3% above your ideal target price, allowing flexibility for offers without appearing unreasonable or overvalued from the outset.
acceptedAnswer.description: To ensure negotiation room for your FSBO asking price, first base it on a thorough comparative market analysis, then consider adding a modest 1-3% margin above your ideal target price to allow flexibility without overpricing.
